text: This pilot just yanked his jet into a turn so hard his body now weighs nine times as much.
His head and helmet now weigh over a hundred pounds.
And his blood gets pulled down into his legs, away from his brain.
His heart pumps as hard as it can, but it can't push blood up that high.
So his G-suit blows up and squeezes his legs to force the blood back up.
He flexes every muscle and takes a sharp breath every three seconds.
But he lets up for one second, and his vision turns gray and closes in like a tunnel.
Then everything goes black while he's still awake, and he passes out.
His hand slips off the stick, and the jet dives straight at the ground.
But the jet sees the ground coming, rolls level, and pulls up all by itself.
He wakes up with no memory of passing out. That system has saved at least thirteen pilots.
Subscribe, because that's what nine G's do to your body.
